photos.alt: A full rainbow arching over a marina and city towers under dark clouds.
An airport terminal entrance with a blue sign reading Welcome to Hawaii.
A rainbow seen through palm fronds beside a high-rise building.
A person in a white shirt and cap looking out over the sunlit sea toward Diamond Head.
A rainbow over a green park and a pond with city towers behind, as someone walks past.
A white lighthouse on a green headland above a blue sea with lines of surf.
Turquoise water foaming over a dark, mossy sea wall.
Close-up of a banyan tree's tangled trunks, carved with names.
People on a beach beyond a green lawn, framed by large banyan trees in low sun.
